title: 第19章 巧舌如簧小狐狸第20章 姜酥柔 我真不是人啊
content_zh:
见状，姜酥柔立刻抬手，挥出一道灵气，将小狐狸给托了起来，然后轻轻的从窗口拿到了屋子里，放到了自己的腿上。
看着小狐狸那惊慌失措的可爱模样，她的心都要被萌化了。
姜酥柔轻轻的抚摸着小狐狸身上的毛发，白色的毛茸茸的，真舒服。
“别害怕小狐狸，二楼的高度又摔不死。”
“可是会疼呀，摔到屁屁很疼很疼的。”
小狐狸仰起小脸，很认真的说道。
“呵呵，真可爱，你来找我，有什么事情吗？”
姜酥柔笑着问道。
她对谁都没笑过，对任何人都不假辞色，唯独对这只可爱的小狐狸最喜欢，也不吝啬自己的笑容。
“姐姐你笑起来真好看，你应该多笑一笑，别人看见你笑，一定很开心。”
“姐姐又不是卖笑的，倒是你这小家伙，真讨人喜欢。”
小狐狸嘿嘿一笑，然后跳到了姜酥柔面前的茶桌上，直立起前蹄，挥舞着小爪子说道，
“我今天来找姐姐，是有两件事。”
看着小狐狸认真又可爱的表情，姜酥柔单手拖着下巴，悠悠笑道，
“你说吧，有什么事情。”
“第一件事，就是人家想姐姐了，想要过来看看姐姐呢，想要跟姐姐贴贴，抱一抱呢。”
“呵呵，小嘴真甜。”
姜酥柔噗嗤一笑，伸手揉了揉它的小脑袋。
“然后呢，第二件事是什么？”
看着姜酥柔那开心的样子，小狐狸心里得意极了，暗道真应该让韩风那个大傻冒过来看看，学学自己是怎么哄女孩子开心的，整天傻不拉几当舔狗，送个礼物都不敢亲自来送。

照你这样，啥时候才能牵到小姐姐的手啊。
“第二件事，就是有礼物要送给姐姐。”
小狐狸拍了拍自己脖子下面的储物袋，然后一把淡蓝色的飞剑出现在了桌子上。
“一把剑？你送我一把剑做什么？”
姜酥柔拿起这把剑，放在手里，输入灵气感受这把剑的质量。
而后，她美目微微惊讶，说道，
“这是一把灵宝啊，应该是下品灵宝的样子，还挺值钱的，哪来的啊？”
灵宝确实很值钱，有些比较穷的筑基修士都还没有灵宝呢，只能用灵器。
只有像姜酥柔这种家业大的，才能用的起灵宝，灵宝也是整个阴阳宗里中层修士的主要中坚武器。
至于法宝，那更是每一件都贵到天上去了，整个阴阳宗里都没有多少，都掌握在长辈们的手里，个个都是宝贝。
姜酥柔肯定也没有。
她自己的本命武器，也只是一把中品灵宝而已，此时看到小狐狸送给自己一把下品灵宝，自然非常惊讶。
小狐狸解释道，
“这是韩风昨天晚上买的，让我帮他送给你。”
“韩风买的？这一把下品灵宝，至少价值两千灵石，他区区一个杂役弟子，哪里买得起这样的灵宝。”
content_en:
Seeing this, Jiang Surou immediately raised her hand, waved a burst of spiritual energy, lifted the little fox up, and then gently brought it into the house from the window and placed it on her lap.
Seeing the little fox's cute and frightened look, her heart almost melted.
Jiang Surou gently stroked the little fox's hair. It was white and fluffy, so comfortable.
"Don't be afraid of the little fox. You can't fall to death from the height of the second floor."
"But it will hurt. If you fall, your butt will hurt."
The little fox raised his face and said seriously.
"Haha, you're so cute. You came to see me. What's the matter?"
Jiang Surou asked with a smile.
She has never smiled at anyone, and she has no pretense towards anyone. She only loves this cute little fox the most, and she is not stingy with her smile.
"Sister, you look so pretty when you smile. You should smile more. Others will be happy when they see you smile."
"Sister, it's not like you're a joker, but you, little guy, are so lovable."
The little fox chuckled, then jumped on the tea table in front of Jiang Surou, stood up on his front hooves, waved his little paws and said,
"I came to see my sister today for two things."
Looking at the serious and cute expression of the little fox, Jiang Surou dragged her chin with one hand and said with a long smile,
"Tell me, what's the matter?"
"The first thing is that I miss my sister. I want to come over and see my sister. I want to cuddle up with her and give her a hug."
"Haha, your little mouth is so sweet."
Jiang Surou chuckled and reached out to rub its little head.
"Then, what's the second thing?"
Seeing Jiang Surou's happy look, the little fox felt extremely proud, and secretly thought that Han Feng, the idiot, should come over and have a look, and learn how to make girls happy. He acted like a licking dog all day long, and he didn't even dare to give gifts in person.
If you act like this, when will you be able to hold the little sister's hand?
"The second thing is that I have a gift for my sister."
The little fox patted the storage bag under his neck, and then a light blue flying sword appeared on the table.
"A sword? Why did you give me a sword?"
Jiang Surou picked up the sword, put it in her hand, and input spiritual energy to feel the quality of the sword.
Then, her beautiful eyes were slightly surprised and she said,
"This is a spiritual treasure. It should be a low-grade spiritual treasure. It is quite valuable. Where did it come from?"
Spiritual treasures are indeed very valuable. Some relatively poor foundation-building monks do not yet have spiritual treasures and can only use spiritual weapons.
Only those with a big family fortune like Jiang Surou can use Lingbao. Lingbao is also the main weapon for the middle-level monks in the entire Yin Yang Sect.
As for magic weapons, each one is extremely expensive. There are not many of them in the entire Yin Yang Sect. They are all in the hands of the elders, and all of them are treasures.
Jiang Surou definitely didn’t either.
Her own natural weapon was only a middle-grade spiritual treasure. At this time, she was naturally very surprised when she saw the little fox giving her a low-grade spiritual treasure.
The little fox explained,
"Han Feng bought this last night and asked me to give it to you for him."
"Did Han Feng buy it? This low-grade spiritual treasure is worth at least two thousand spiritual stones. How can he, a mere handyman disciple, afford such a spiritual treasure?"
